title: Edexcel International GCSE Physics
description:
Complete Edexcel International GCSE Physics course covering the 4PH1 specification.

Topics include:
• Forces and motion
• Electricity
• Waves
• Energy resources and energy transfer
• Solids, liquids and gases
• Magnetism and electromagnetism
• Radioactivity and particles
• Astrophysics

Includes worked examples, practice problems, and exam-style questions.
subject: physics
